newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm in listless trade.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed firmer on Monday in thin, lacklustre trade as a dearth of fresh factors and the absence of many players for year-end holidays cut activity.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 March contract finished 100 points higher at 20,420 after reaching an early high of 20,480. Turnover was a low 10,000 lots.
Dealers said the March Nikkei gapped up at the open following a firm finish in Chicago on Friday, where the Dow's recovery from sharp sell-offs earlier last week shored up sentiment.
"The Dow recovered quite well on Friday, so that gave a little direction to the market for this week," said a Japanese bank dealer.
But he said there had been little movement after the firm start and the March Nikkei was likely to shuffle sideways between 20,300 and 20,800 for the rest of the year.

A trader with a local institution said the March Nikkei needed to close above 20,550 in order to head higher but the intra-day high of 20,480, which was also Chicago's high on Friday, would pose some resistance.
"If it sinks below 20,215, the immediate term outlook is still bad," he added.
